onSheet.sheet: on the sheet — the player sees it

grants.title: What every sheet of this type gets
grants.sub: Buttons and rules that every sheet of this type has.
grants.common: Also in effect for all sheets: {{names}}.

fields.title: How fields are calculated for this type
fields.emptyTitle: the type has no formulas of its own
fields.emptyHint: For example, "+2 to armor class" for every enemy. A rule that changes a roll or another effect is a "hanging · modifies" effect from the "Effects" tab, granted above.

sheetKind.extendsHint: The base's grants and modifiers pass to this type.

list.head: books
list.emptyHint: a type is a form to fill in: which numbers to ask a person for and which effects to bind them to.
list.pickTitle: Pick a type on the left
list.pickHint: A record asks only for its own numbers, and the button appears on the holder by itself. That is what is set up here.

builtIn.title: Ship with the system
builtIn.note: Built-in records of the system — they go into any world on this system, ahead of the books.

kind.extendsHint: The base's properties and buttons pass to this type; its own first button modifies the base's first button.
kind.iconHint: One symbol on the buttons of this book's records

props.title: Properties
props.sub: What is filled in for every record of this type in the book.
props.nowhere: goes nowhere — just a note on the record

buttons.title: Buttons on the sheet
buttons.noEffects: The system has no effects yet — nothing to connect. Create them on the "Effects" tab.

hanging.title: Hangs on the holder
hanging.sub: While the record is on the sheet.

mods.title: What every item of this type modifies
mods.sub: Written once — in effect while any item of this type is worn. What is specific to one item is edited in the compendium.
mods.emptyHint: Modifiers while the sheet has any item of this type. Written once here — every record of the type gets them without a line of its own.

button.label: Button on the sheet
button.onlyHolder: "{{name}}" takes only whoever pressed and the targets — nothing to fill in.
button.ifHint: While the condition is false, the record has no such button.
button.fillsBy: "{{name}}" — what the type fills it with
button.addPropTitle: create the property "{{name}}" on the type: every record has its own value, filled in the book

choose.error: {{label}} — a row of the table "{{from}}", but a row of "{{need}}" is needed here

grants.argsOf: “{{name}}”: how each item fills the inputs
grants.nothingHint: Nothing to grant yet — create an effect on the "Effects" tab: "+ hanging" or "+ button".

donors.own: the system already has its own "{{name}}" — the ready-made one will not replace it

effectPick.passed: What was passed into the input

tags.computedTitle: the tag is calculated by a formula at the roll
tags.unknownTitle: this tag is not in the roll tag dictionary

sees.owner: whoever plays the sheet, and the game master

table.startNote: the text a sheet is created with
table.startFormula: formula: the field equals it until it is touched
table.toFormulaTitle: the field equals a formula until it is touched: for example, hit points equal the maximum
table.title: Caption
table.viewColumn: View of the column "{{name}}" in the block "{{block}}"
table.note: Text on the sheet — a multi-line field across the full width of the block.
table.likeColumnHint: the column's view in this block: {{view}}
table.noColumnView: the column has no view in this block — as is
table.plainStored: a box: the player enters a number or text
table.plainComputed: a plain value — a formula calculates it, it cannot be entered
table.lacking: The view "{{view}}" lacks: {{what}}. Until it is set, the sheet shows "—" instead.
table.topPlaceholder: a number or a formula: 3 or a field name
table.stepsNumbers: Steps are numbers from the bottom to the top (at most 8). For words, use the "choice" type and a table.
table.stepsTable: Steps are the rows of the table "{{table}}" in order; captions come from there.
table.stepsNone: Options are set like this: the "choice" type → "From a table".
